source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of utilizing digital resources (PDF 199).

blocks.text: Digital wasail ka istemal ka matlab online dastiyab auzaar aur maloomat, jaise articles, videos aur websites, ko apne kaam ya parhai ke liye mo-assar tareeqe se istemal karna hai.

blocks.prompt: School project ke liye teen qism ke digital wasail bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Online articles, taleemi videos aur ilmi databases ya e-libraries.

items: Digital wasail: parhai ke liye achhi tarah istemal shuda online articles, videos aur websites.
